ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white to 25% low-intensity black across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central white contiguous areas on both lobes. High-contrast black banding along the entire trailing edge and tips. Dense black mottling and speckling radiating from the insertion point and along the leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 45-50 degree interior angle and significant vertical depth relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the full trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations forming distinct, jagged peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on trailing edges tapering to sharp, pointed distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several localized dark circular pixel clusters visible against the white background, concentrated on the lower-middle sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible: at least three on the left lobe and two on the right lobe, oriented diagonally to the fluke axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Cluster of barnacle colonization visible on the distal tip of the left lobe; multiple vertical and diagonal rake mark scars across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-contrast 'spatter' pigmentation pattern concentrated around the median notch area.
